name: Chengdu Spaceon Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Spaceon Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of time-frequency and satellite application products in China and internationally. The company offers atomic clocks, crystal devices, and radio frequency components and equipment. It also offers timing and synchronization series products, such as time and frequency boards and modules, power modules and components, and time synchronization equipment and systems.
